patents.inventors: Ching-Sung Yang; Shih-Jye Shen; Ching-Hsiang Hsu
patents.coreProblem: Store charge in a single-poly cell without a control-gate programming bias.
patents.mechanism: Two series PMOS devices provide selection and floating-gate charge storage through hot-carrier injection.

patents.inventors: Meng-Yi Wu; Chi-Yi Shao; Ching-Sung Yang
patents.coreProblem: Coordinate random sources and pool updates across initialization and operation.
patents.mechanism: Static output switches from an initial pool to an operating pool; dynamic entropy drives a counter, and combined output refreshes a lively pool and then the static pool.

patents.title: Key management system providing secure management of cryptographic keys, and methods of operating the same
patents.inventors: Yung-Hsiang Liu; Meng-Yi Wu; Ching-Sung Yang
patents.coreProblem: Distribute key requests across components and retain recoverable backups.
patents.mechanism: A load balancer selects the least-loaded derivation component; backups wrap the key with their own PUF sequences, and identifiers support retrieval.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 requires multiple PUF/KDF/KWP/memory components, least-load dispatch and a backup channel. The generating component disables KWP and stores identifier/parameters; backups disable KDF and store wrapped keys. A retrieval dispatched to the generating component matches the identifier and re-derives the key.
